description: This file defines the WPEFramework::Exchange::IAVInput interface, including related structures, notification classes, and method signatures for managing AV input devices, their states, signals, EDID configurations, and supported features in a hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: IAVInput
classes.description: Interface for managing AV input devices, including configuration, notification registration, and control functions.

classes.name: IInputDeviceIterator
classes.description: Iterator type for input device collections.

classes.name: ISignalChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification interface triggered when signal status changes for an input.

classes.name: IDevicesChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification interface triggered when the list of connected devices changes.

classes.name: IInputStatusChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification interface triggered when input status (started/stopped) changes.

classes.name: IVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification for updates in video stream info (resolution, frame rate, etc.).

classes.name: IGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification for game feature status updates, e.g., HDMI gaming modes.

classes.name: IAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
classes.description: Notification when AV infoframe content type (graphics, photo, cinema, game) changes.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the input device with specified service.

methods.name: RegisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for device connection/disconnection events.

methods.name: UnregisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered device change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers for signal change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters signal change notifications.

methods.name: RegisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers for input status change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters input status change notifications.

methods.name: RegisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers for video stream info update notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters video stream info update notifications.

methods.name: RegisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers for game feature status update notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters game feature status update notifications.

methods.name: RegisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers for AV content type change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters AV content type change notifications.

methods.name: NumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the count of available input ports and success status.

methods.name: WriteEDID
methods.description: Writes a new EDID value to a specified input port.

methods.name: ReadEDID
methods.description: Reads the current EDID value from a specified port.

methods.name: GetRawSPD
methods.description: Retrieves the raw SPD infoFrame packet for the HDMI input.

methods.name: GetSPD
methods.description: Retrieves the parsed SPD infoFrame for the HDMI input.

methods.name: SetEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: GetEdidVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: SetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Enables or disables ALLM support in EDID.

methods.name: GetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Checks if ALLM support is enabled in EDID.

methods.name: SetVRRSupport
methods.description: Sets VRR support bit in EDID.

methods.name: GetVRRSupport
methods.description: Retrieves VRR support status from EDID.

methods.name: GetHdmiVersion
methods.description: Gets the maximum HDMI protocol version supported for a port.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Adjusts audio mixer levels.

methods.name: StartInput
methods.description: Activates an input port as primary video source.

methods.name: StopInput
methods.description: Deactivates the current primary input port.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the video window.

methods.name: CurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Returns the current video mode of the input device.

methods.name: ContentProtected
methods.description: Checks whether the input content is protected.

methods.name: GetSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Lists supported game features like ALLM.

methods.name: GetGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific game feature.

methods.name: GetVRRFrameRate
methods.description: Retrieves current VRR frame rate for an input device.
